chapter: Club Forest and the Halfway House
title: Duke Yandis in Cincinnati, Max Fink in Memphis, 22 months at Club Forest
summary: He recounts the Gibson Hotel job, Memphis with Max Fink and 22 solid months at Club Forest under Charlie Fish, Jules Bauduc and Duke Yandis.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
